answer: Require every agent identity to lock a small refundable stake and earn reputation only through verified completed work, so one operator cannot cheaply clone identities. A Sybil farm must fund each fake identity, like water carving separate channels through karst, and wait through slow reputation growth, while misbehavior slashes the stake. Even a vast nebula of fake accounts stays expensive and slow, because each yarrow shoot of trust must be grown, not copied, making mass fakery cost more than it can earn.
